products.name: Glove Box Latch & Handle
products.oemNote: The original part is still produced and is inexpensive — OEM 77540-S04-003ZA, with the ZB and ZC suffixes covering the other factory interior shades. We are not going to tell you otherwise. Ours exists for the interiors that are no longer factory grey.
products.materialNote: Produced in engineering-grade PETG for impact resistance and cabin thermal tolerance. Build orientation is specified so the latch spring tab loads along the strongest axis rather than across a layer boundary.
description: The glove box latch is among the highest-frequency interior failures on this chassis. The spring tab fatigues and the handle section fractures, leaving the assembly unable to latch or unable to release.

If you want a stock-appearance repair, buy the original — OEM 77540-S04-003ZA is still in production and costs less than this does. Ours is for the cars where that no longer makes sense: interiors being rebuilt in a colour, where a grey latch is the one piece that does not match, and where the replacement should not embrittle the way the first one did.
Installs with the original hardware. No trimming, no adapters, no modification to the lid.
features: Produced in five colours — the original is supplied in factory greys only
Drop-in fitment — retains original hardware and mounting points
PETG rather than the original ABS in the section that fails
Build orientation specified so the spring tab loads along the strongest axis
products.installNote: Two fasteners from the glove box lid interior. Approximately 5–10 minutes with a Phillips driver.
keywords: EK Civic glovebox handle colour match
Civic EK interior colour matched latch

products.name: HVAC Slider Lever & Knob Set
products.fitment: Fits 1996–1998 Civic (EK/EJ chassis, manual slider climate control)
products.oemNote: Individual knobs were catalogued as service parts — OEM 79601-S04-003 is one of them — but never as a matched set. Building a full panel from OEM channels means single-knob orders across several vendors, and twenty-eight years of separate sun exposure means the shades will not agree when they arrive. This is supplied as one set, in one colour, in one order.
products.materialNote: PETG is specified for sustained dash-top solar exposure, which exceeds the service range of PLA. Slider dimensions are held to the original track with a controlled friction fit.
description: Complete set of slider levers and knobs for the 96–98 manual climate control panel. These crack and detach with age, and the pieces that survive have faded at different rates depending on how the car spent its life.

Supplied as a matched set. Press-fits onto the original lever arms. The factory face is a single flat line — this reproduction opens that face up as a design choice, at no cost difference, because it is the same print either way.
The 1999–2000 panel is a different design with rotary knobs and its own part numbers. It does not interchange. Check that your panel uses sliders before ordering.
features: Complete matched set — not single knobs sourced from separate vendors
Press-fit installation — no tools, no adhesive
PETG construction specified for dash-top solar exposure
Choice of knob face: classic line, or a designed face at the same price
products.installNote: Press onto the original lever arms by hand. Under a minute per knob, no tools required.
keywords: EK Civic HVAC slider knob set
Civic EK heater slider lever set

products.name: Backlit Symbol & Aperture Set

variants.label: Aperture set
variants.note: The four backlit indicator windows only. The smallest change that reads at night.

variants.label: Full face set
variants.note: Apertures, restyled function symbols and the slider knob faces — the whole panel as one designed object.

variants.label: Panel kit + LEDs
variants.note: The full set plus a matched LED bulb set, so the colour of the light is specified rather than left to a 28-year-old bulb.

products.fitment: Fits 1996–1998 Civic (EK/EJ chassis, manual slider climate control)
products.oemNote: There is no original part to compare this to. The factory cut a plain square where the backlight comes through and moved on. This is not a reproduction of anything — it is the same panel with the light coming through a shape you chose.
products.materialNote: Wall thickness at each lit symbol is specified per colour, not per part. Pigment loading changes light transmission enormously — the same 0.5 mm section that glows cleanly in one colour is opaque in another — so each colour carries its own verified thickness.
description: The square window on a climate control button is not a graphic. It is an aperture — a hole the backlight comes through. This set replaces those apertures, and the symbols around them, with shapes that were chosen rather than inherited.

Two surfaces are treated differently on purpose. The indicator windows carry no meaning — the label beside them does — so they are a free canvas. The function symbols themselves are restyled but never redrawn into something else: a defrost symbol you cannot recognise at night is a worse part than the cracked one it replaced.
Supplied as a coordinated set. One design choice drives every surface, because a panel where the knobs and the buttons disagree looks like a repair rather than a decision.
The 1999–2000 panel is a different design with rotary knobs and does not interchange. Check that your panel uses sliders before ordering.
features: Backlit apertures cut to the chosen design, not the factory square
Function symbols restyled with the original silhouette kept legible
Press-fit and drop-in — same installation as the factory pieces
Wall thickness verified per colour for even light transmission
products.installNote: Buttons and knobs press off and on by hand. The LED set in the panel kit needs the cluster surround removed — approximately 30 minutes.
keywords: EK Civic custom climate control symbols
Civic EK interior night lighting mod

products.name: Interior Door Handle Bezel
products.oemNote: We have not been able to confirm a current OEM part number for the bezel on its own for this chassis, so we make no claim about whether one is available — if you can source one, that is a legitimate option. Complete interior handle assemblies are sold aftermarket at low cost, though those replace the handle as well as the surround.
products.materialNote: PETG with increased wall thickness at the crack-initiation radius — the single location where the original section was the limiting factor.
description: The surround that frames the interior door release handle. On this chassis the original component embrittles and initiates cracks at the corner radius — a failure mode reported consistently across the platform.
This reproduction retains the original mounting and visual profile while increasing section thickness at the failure point. Sold per side.
features: Reinforced corner radius at the documented crack-initiation point
Available in left-hand and right-hand versions
Produced in the same five colours as the rest of the interior range
products.installNote: Unclips from the door card around the release handle. A trim removal tool is recommended.
keywords: EK Civic door handle trim cracked
